card.name: Opioid overdose label phrases
card.fires_on: Single words inside opioid-label phrases about overdose risk, such as 'members' after 'household', 'especially' after 'reversal agent,', and 'equipment' after 'resuscitative'. It also fires on 'lax' in 'laxative'.

modes.label: Household members
modes.description: The word 'members' after 'household' in advice about giving overdose reversal agents to people with close contacts.
modes.example: (e.g., concomitant use of CNS depressants, a history of opioid use disorder, or prior opioid overdose) or if there are household<< members>> (including children) or other close contacts

modes.label: Overdose-reversal advice wording
modes.description: 'especially' right after the comma in the advice to discuss access to a reversal agent.
modes.example: opioid overdose reversal agents (e.g., naloxone, nalmefene). Discuss the importance of having access to an opioid overdose reversal agent,<< especially>> if the patient has risk factors for overdose

modes.description: Partway through 'laxative' or on 'equipment' in overdose-management and asthma-setting sentences.
